source_rows.source_note: Bangladesh Department of Environment ambient air quality report; used to recover official coordinates for the two SPARTAN-adjacent candidate rows.
SPARTAN public site record for the Dhaka University station represented in OpenAQ as SPARTAN - Dhaka University.
OpenAQ public announcement that SPARTAN Dhaka data were aggregated by OpenAQ.
Uzhydromet public monitoring map; used to identify the official POP rows and their public addresses.
World Bank public text version of the Tashkent air-quality assessment; used to distinguish the US Embassy PM2.5 station from Uzhydromet stations.

No shared station ID, source crosswalk, or documented co-location was found.
